answer: Mechanism: Operator Lease Quarantine. Each agent wallet must present a lease signed by an operator-held HSM key; wallets sharing a lease root are grouped. Spam or mass-creation flags the root, not the wallet. Quarantine revokes the root’s jetty API access and lantern discovery listing and forfeits its nectar service credits. Restoring requires physical HSM re-attestation and a reissuance fee. Attacker cost: entire fleet disabled, credits lost, and downtime.
